svg.text: Know the facts · Protect · Stay healthy
Health information from the reviewed sources listed below.
Rabies is a viral disease that is usually
transmitted through the saliva of infected
animals, often by a bite or scratch. After a
possible exposure, wash the wound immediately
with soap and running water and seek urgent
medical care for assessment and post-exposure
prophylaxis. Do not wait for symptoms.
Educational information · Not a diagnosis or replacement for professional care
